functions.name: BeginDestroy
functions.docs: Handle when this action is being destroyed to ensure that the action is canceled and child classes can clean up.

functions.name: Cancel
functions.docs: Cancel an asynchronous action, this attempts to cancel any lower level processes and also prevents delegates from being fired

functions.name: IsActive
functions.docs: Returns true if this action is still active and has not completed or been cancelled

functions.name: ShouldBroadcastDelegates
functions.docs: This should be called prior to broadcasting delegates back into the event graph, this ensures the action is still valid

functions.name: IsRegistered
functions.docs: Returns true if this action is registered with a valid game instance

functions.name: GetTimerManager
functions.docs: Wrapper function to get a timer manager for scheduling callbacks
